hero.subtitle: Three decades of clinical practice. Proprietary herbal formulations rooted in the Charak Samhita. Trusted by 80,000+ patients across India.

about.p1: It started in 1995, in a quiet corner of Rajasthan, with a single Ayurvedic practice and a simple promise — to treat each patient with the care and patience our shastras demand.
about.p2: For years, that meant free health camps in the dust of Sirsa, Ganganagar, Gurugram, and Mahendragarh. Word travelled from village to village. Families came back. Then their children came. By 1999, our flagship clinic in Nohar was permanent. By 2009, we built our own GMP-certified manufacturing — because the only way to guarantee purity end-to-end is to make the medicines ourselves.
about.p3: Today, three clinics serve over 80,000 patients across North India. The promise hasn't changed.
